shared_elements: low relief carving on tan/honey-coloured stone
quadruped animal shown in profile with the body in shallow relief
animal legs rendered as vertical ribbed/columnar forms
horizontal band of repeated motifs running above the animal figures
flat background plane with figures raised only slightly
justification: Both surfaces set profile quadrupeds in shallow relief beneath a horizontal register of repeated motifs, and both share the same warm sunlit stone and lightly raised, unmodelled background, which makes the raking-light impression comparable. The biggest difference is scale and treatment: A is a tight crop of anatomically modelled, muscular animal bodies with fine incised detail, whereas B is a whole free-standing pillar carrying flatter, more schematic and outline-like creatures stacked over several zones.
